items.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01
items.q: Bill Russell is identified only as the interviewer ('This is Bill Russell') and no interaction or personal relationship with the interviewee (Emile Barnes) is described in the text.

ctx.x: So we're all ready to start. I'll give my voice. This is Bill Russell and we're down at the home of Mealy Barnes and Paul Barnes on Louisa Street. Do you want to give your name Mr. Mealy Barnes, Emile Barnes? Mm-hmm. What is your full name? My full name is Emile Barnes. Any middle name or initial? Mealy Barnes. Oh. That's Mealy.
They're going again. You were talking, was it Buddy Petit you said you played with?

items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-08-22
items.q: Mr. Bill, I waited all my days since I was 13.

ctx.x: You see, that gets the music in your head first? Yes. Before anything else gets.
Mr. Bill, I waited all my days since I was 13. My daddy left home when I was 13 years old.
And you had to work then?
